jobs.title: Aviation Security & Airport Patrol Officer
jobs.description:
City of San Antonio is seeking an Airport Police Officer to safeguard San Antonio International Airport. You will enforce laws, protect the public, and support TSA screening across terminals and air operations areas.

The role involves responding to emergencies, issuing citations, and preparing detailed reports. A TX Peace Officer license, valid driver’s license, and English proficiency are required; CJIS/TSA clearances must be passed.

Candidates should have a high school diploma or GED, experience in security work, and a valid Texas driver’s license. Successful applicants must pass TSA clearance, reflecting the position’s importance in maintaining a secure environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr
